# HubSpot

> HubSpot is an AI-powered customer platform offering integrated CRM, marketing, sales, service, content, data, and commerce software for businesses of all sizes.

HubSpot provides a unified customer platform with AI-driven tools like Breeze agents for automation and intelligence. The platform serves startups through enterprises with modular hubs designed to streamline business operations and customer relationships.

## Key Topics

- Smart CRM
- Breeze AI
- Customer Platform
- AI Agents
- Sales Hub
- Marketing Hub
- Service Hub
- Content Hub
- Data Hub
- Commerce Hub
- Prospecting Agent
- Customer Agent
- Data Agent
- CRM Software
- Customer Engagement

## Core Products & Hubs

- [HubSpot CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm): Free CRM with contact management, deal tracking, and live chat capabilities
- [AI CRM (Smart CRM)](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm): AI-powered Smart CRM with data unification and intelligent insights
- [Sales Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales): AI-powered sales software with prospecting agent and deal management tools
- [Marketing Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing): AI-powered marketing platform with email, forms, and automation workflows
- [Service Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service): AI-powered customer service platform with help desk and omnichannel support
- [Content Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content): Content management and multi-channel publishing software for marketing teams
- [Data Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/data): Data integration and quality management for scaling businesses
- [Commerce Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/commerce): AI CPQ, billing, and payment processing software for revenue growth

## AI & Automation

- [Breeze AI](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence): HubSpot's Breeze AI tools including assistant and agents for business automation

## Getting Started & Plans

- [Get Started with HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/get-started): Onboarding and getting started guide for new HubSpot users
- [HubSpot Starter Plan](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/starter): Starter customer platform plan for small businesses and startups at $20/month
